description: Makita XDT19Z Quick-Shift Mode™ 18V LXT® Lithium-Ion 4-Speed Cordless Impact Driver, Tool Only - Distributed/Packaged by Makita. Product Details: Makita has a heritage of innovation in the cordless impact driver category, and the LXT 18V 4-Speed Brushless Impact Driver (XDT19Z) sets new standards. The XDT19 offers 4-speed power selections (0-1100/0-2,100/0-3,200/0-3,600 rpm and 0-1,100/0-2,600/0-3,600/0-3,800 IPM) that provides precise fixation control for a wide range of range of applications.The impact driver has an assist mode (mode A) that helps eliminate "cam-out screws" and "cross threading" by driving at low speeds until tightening begins. It also has two clamping modes (T mode) for faster tightening of self-drilling screws into thick or thin metal that helps prevent damage to the screw or workpiece. The XDT19 delivers cutting-edge performance in a compact, ergonomic design.Additional features include the 4-speed power selection knob under the chuck, which allows for one-handed speed changes, and the reverse rotation automatic stop mode that stops rotation and impact when the fastener is loosened properly to help prevent excessive loosening and falling.It is part of Makita's 18V LXT expandable system, the world's largest cordless tool system powered by 18V lithium-ion batteries. Makita 18V LXT batteries have the fastest charging times in their class, so they spend more time working and less time sitting on the charger.To improve tool performance and extend battery life, Makita created Star Protection Computer Controls. Star Protection is a communication technology that allows the tool and battery equipped with Star Protection to exchange data in real time and monitor conditions during use to protect against overcharging, over-discharge and overheating. For added versatility, the tool can also be powered by compact Makita 18V LXT and lithium-ion batteries with the star symbol on the battery indicating protection of the stars inside.
